observations: Original uses a quarter-circle open deck and coral rails, with very thin/bare support structure and abrupt planar rim top. Native intrinsic rotation measured as zero, unlike another corner orientation.

Fixed target softens rail cross section, adds a timber skirt and rounded legs with small brass pins, and richer slate panel relief. These useful changes fit as curved support and subtle fastener detail.

Family render has a deliberately restrained coral/slate/timber palette and narrow continuous rail/deck profiles. Need use exact approved family materials and matching connectors; target broad highlight must not expand end profile.
Source identity, actual angular parameterization, incoming/outgoing tangents and phase must be measured and retained; target framing/caps are not authoritative.
No camera fit or per-facing lighting adjustment is appropriate. Native four directions and full motion evidence will decide continuity.
